candidates.headline: Sources: Giants QB Jaxson Dart out for extended period
candidates.description: Jaxson Dart's knee injury is more severe than originally anticipated, and the Giants quarterback could miss the rest of the season, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo.

candidates.headline: Packers lose RT Zach Bako-Bewele to season-ending surgery
candidates.description: Packers RT Zach Bako-Bewele, considered the team's best offensive lineman, is set to undergo knee surgery that will sideline him for 8-10 months.

candidates.headline: Van Ness' breakout game saves Packers in OT win vs. Jets
candidates.description: Packers hope it's a sign of things to come as Micah Parsons nears his return from a torn ACL.

candidates.headline: Jets rookie WR Omar Cooper Jr. put on IR with sprained ankle
candidates.description: Jets rookie wide receiver Omar Cooper Jr., one of the team's three first-round picks, has been placed on injured reserve with a sprained ankle.

candidates.headline: Vikings to start QB Wentz vs. Bears with Murray still on the mend
candidates.description: Carson Wentz will be the Vikings' starting quarterback Sunday against the Bears while Kyler Murray continues to work his way back after suffering a concussion in the season opener.

candidates.headline: Stephon Gilmore, '19 NFL DPOY, retires as member of the Patriots
candidates.description: Stephon Gilmore, a two-time All-Pro cornerback and the NFL's 2019 Defensive Player of the Year, signed a one-day contract in New England on Friday to retire as a member of the Patriots,

candidates.headline: Career-defining season for Vikings coach Kevin O'Connell?
candidates.description: O'Connell has had tremendous regular-season success, but is this the season it extends into the playoffs?

candidates.headline: Drew Lock: Taking care of football key in Seahawks start
candidates.description: As Drew Lock steps into a starting role for the Seattle Seahawks, the veteran quarterback knows he doesn't have to force the issue while he fills in for the injured Sam Darnold.

candidates.headline: Bad game or bad sign: Which players should you be concerned about entering Week 2?
candidates.description: It's easy to overreact to Week 1. Matt Bowen discusses whether concern is warranted for 13 players.

candidates.headline: Buccaneers' Zampese says Browns messed up by trading Mayfield
candidates.description: Buccaneers assistant coach Ken Zampease, who was Baker Mayfield's QB coach with the Browns in 2018, says Cleveland messed up by trading the QB.

candidates.headline: 49ers' De'Zhaun Stribling has surgery, to miss about 10 weeks
candidates.description: 49ers receiver De'Zhaun Stribling had surgery on his ankle and is expected to miss about 10 weeks, while tight end Jake Tonges has been ruled out for the season.

candidates.headline: Vikings RB Jordan Mason put on IR after having surgery on thumb
candidates.description: Vikings running back Jordan Mason was placed on injured reserve Wednesday after undergoing surgery to repair a fractured thumb.

candidates.headline: Kenneth Walker III, Patrick Mahomes lead Chiefs' win vs. Broncos
candidates.description: Quarterback Patrick Mahomes, making his return from a torn ACL, and running back Kenneth Walker III, making his Chiefs debut, powered Kansas City to a season-opening blowout win over Denver.

candidates.headline: Sources: Joey Porter Jr. unlikely to play amid uncertain Steelers future
candidates.description: Steelers cornerback Joey Porter Jr., who has been embroiled in a contract dispute all summer, is unlikely to play against the Falcons because of a back injury, sources told NFL Network and ESPN, and the possibility of a trade remains in play.

candidates.headline: Sources: Maxx Crosby shut down Rams trade talks after failed Ravens deal
candidates.description: The Rams pursued Maxx Crosby shortly after his trade from the Raiders to the Ravens fell through, sources told NFL Network.

candidates.headline: Source: Jaguars, Parker Washington unlikely to agree to deal
candidates.description: The Jaguars and Parker Washington are unlikely to agree to a contract extension before the start of the season, a source told NFL Network.

candidates.headline: Sources: Lamar Jackson won't have deal before start of season
candidates.description: Lamar Jackson has been reluctant to discuss a long-term extension with the Ravens and has been more focused on the upcoming 2026 season, league sources told ESPN.

candidates.headline: Sources: C.J. Stroud, Texans to table extension talks
candidates.description: The Texans and C.J. Stroud made a run at completing a contract extension before the regular season begins, but both sides agreed they now prefer to wait until after this season to work out a long-term deal, sources told ESPN and NFL Network.

candidates.headline: Raiders TE Michael Mayer gets 3-year, $45M extension, sources say
candidates.description: Tight end Michael Mayer, who is stepping in for an injured Brock Bowers to start the regular season, has received a multiyear extension from the Raiders.

candidates.headline: Sources: Packers, TE Tucker Kraft agree to 4-year extension
candidates.description: The Packers and tight end Tucker Kraft have reached agreement on a four-year extension worth up to $92 million, sources told ESPN.

candidates.headline: Sources: Bears, RB Swift agree to 3-year, $33.75M extension
candidates.description: The Bears and running back D'Andre Swift have reached an agreement on a three-year, $33.75 million extension that includes $27.5 million guaranteed, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

candidates.headline: Texans rookie Kayden McDonald placed on IR with ankle injury
candidates.description: Texans rookie defensive tackle Kayden McDonald (ankle) was placed on injured reserve, meaning he'll have to wait four weeks to make his debut.
